items.difficulty_reason: 7 行陈述、相对循环的等维性是 Zariski 局部可查：定义等价复述 + 闭包与开限制交换（标准事实，已述未具名）故可局部化。作者自标 (small detail omitted) 系指针式收尾、路线已全给，同 span_audit 先例不计承重，注记透明，判干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-check-equidimensional (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1585-1591

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Equidimensional just means the closure of the support has relative dimension at most r over S; since taking closures commutes with restriction to opens, the check may be done Zariski locally on X and S (the author marks the final assembly as a small detail omitted) (source lines 1593-1598)
